title: When gratitude feels distant under pressure
issueStatement: The heart notices absence faster than gift. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru keeps gratitude close to remembrance, contentment, and restored vision. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Hardship is not automatically holy, but it can become the place where reality is finally faced. Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement.
actionPrompt: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
